# Vendored libraries

Copied unmodified from npm so the site has no build step and no third-party CDN at runtime.

| File | Package | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gsap.min.js` | gsap | 3.15.1 | GSAP Standard "no charge" license — https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | gsap | 3.15.1 | same |
| `lenis.min.js` | lenis | 1.3.27 | MIT — https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis |

To update: `npm i gsap lenis`, then copy `dist/gsap.min.js`, `dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js` and `dist/lenis.min.js` here.
